children: Malaysia's central bank kept its benchmark interest rate (MYINTR=ECI) steady for the seventh straight policy meeting on Thursday, amid strong economic growth and moderate inflation.
Bank Negara Malaysia maintained its overnight policy rate at 2.75%, as had been expected by all but two of 31 economists surveyed in a Reuters poll.
